mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous GDP growth (GDPC1 > 1.0% annualized) and housing starts expansion (HOUST > 550.0 thousand) indicate robust economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both GDPC1 growth exceeds 1.0% and HOUST exceeds 550.0.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized) combined with rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 0.1%) triggers aggressive monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% and FEDFUNDS rises.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100.0 (INDPRO > 100.0) indicates strong manufacturing output, boosting corporate profitability and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 500.0 thousand (HOUST < 500.0) reflect weak consumer demand for dwellings, signaling broader economic softness and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST falls below 500.0.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) creates favorable conditions for corporate expansion and equity returns, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market strength with accommodative policy
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% and FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Residential sales growth (RSAFS growth > 1.0% annualized) in late-cycle expansion regimes signals sustained consumer spending momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS growth exceeds 1.0% in late-cycle expansion.
